Some guns hide secret functions that have nothing to do with firepower. The Israeli Galil rifle, built after the 1967 Six-Day War and based on captured AK-47 designs, features a built-in bottle opener and a hidden wire cutter in its bipod — clever solutions to real problems soldiers faced in the field. Discover more hidden firearm secrets at Simple History.
